title: Fixed Open Wing Radial Dartboard Cabinet
description: One newly authored complete fixed-open dartboard cabinet exterior. A full shallow wooden back-and-side enclosure with a grounded bottom sill and wider top cornice carries a separate thick radial target disc. Two whole door wings are fixed outward on four visible hinge barrels; each has one blank inset inner panel. The continuous closed target disc has real connected radial face subdivision with alternating pale and dark sectors, red and green ring zones, a central face and separate thin proud annular and radial boundaries. All colours are opaque constant face-material assignments, never an image texture or overlapping flat decal. No old cabinet or target mesh is imported. One whole model and zero scenes, five opaque untextured PBR materials, metres, Z up and whole ground-centred origin. Door pose is fixed; no arrows, darts, numbers, scoring apparatus, wall, working wall fasteners, characters, throwing simulation, impact response, load or safety performance are supplied. Static illustrative game art only; the ground-centred presentation does not claim a freestanding use configuration.
